deals.loanType: Floating: 1-mo Term SOFR + 2.35% (swap-hedged); IO through 12/1/2026 then 25-yr amortization
deals.debtRecourse: 10% principal guaranty (burns off at stabilization, defined as DSC 1.30x) plus completion / interest / operating-carry guaranties; converts to non-recourse + standard carve-outs at stabilization. Guarantors: Daniel Katz, Daniel Kaufthal.
deals.notes: Cooks Corner Shopping Center is a ~300,000 SF grocery-anchored regional power center in Brunswick, Maine (Cumberland County), at the signalized Bath Rd / US-1 intersection (25,000+ VPD), neighboring Bath Iron Works, Bowdoin College and Mid Coast Hospital. KPR-owned (borrowing entity Brunswick MZL, LLC). Anchored by Hannaford (grocery, 47,429 SF, Ahold Delhaize), TJ Maxx (30,000 SF), Staples (15,664 SF) and Dollar Tree (12,000 SF), with Hobby Lobby (55,000 SF) signed and commencing 7/29/2026 in former big-box space. A strong outparcel/pad ring (ground-leased Burger King, plus Applebee's, KFC/Taco Bell, Five Guys, Jersey Mike's, Advance Auto, Verizon, T-Mobile, Camden National Bank) posts high reported sales (KFC $873 PSF, Five Guys $787, Jersey Mike's $710). The value story is lease-up: ~33% vacant today (67% occupied) from the departed legacy anchors — Sears (40,000 SF, suite 2), Regal Cinema (29,000 SF, suite 18-A) and Big Lots (26,890 SF, suite 110) — with Hobby Lobby backfilling part of it. Refinanced 8/2025 with Washington Trust ($17.54M, floating SOFR+2.35% hedged ~6.09%, IO to 12/2026 then 25-yr amort, matures 8/2028); a ~$3M escrow funds Hobby Lobby TI/LC and the $400K Sears termination fee was added to reserves. No operating statement was in the data set, so NOI is not yet populated.

Hobby Lobby (55,000 SF, suite 100) is SIGNED-NOT-OPEN — lease commences 7/29/2026 at $7.25 PSF ($398,750); it backfills former big-box space and lifts leased occupancy toward ~85%. Guarantor: William C. Bean.

Big vacancies are departed legacy anchors: Sears (40,000 SF, suite 2; $400K termination fee), Regal Cinema (29,000 SF, suite 18-A), Big Lots (26,890 SF, suite 110), plus small inline vacancy (13B 2,562 SF). These are the lease-up opportunity.

The .xls is KPR's LEASE-ABSTRACT workbook (Issues Summary + a tab per tenant), not a financial model — it's best loaded via the deal's 'Upload abstracts' (the new reader handles .xls) to populate the abstracts + lease-risk table. Renewal-option counts here came from its Issues Summary.

redFlags.description: ~33% vacant (67% occupied) from three departed legacy anchors (Sears 40,000 SF, Regal Cinema 29,000 SF, Big Lots 26,890 SF). Hobby Lobby (55,000 SF) backfills part of it on 7/29/2026, but material lease-up / capital (TI/LC) risk remains on the rest.

Floating-rate debt: 1-mo Term SOFR + 2.35% (~6.09% all-in, swap-hedged), 3-yr term maturing 8/1/2028 with a ~$17.05M balloon. IO only through 12/1/2026, then amortizing — debt service steps up in 2027. Refinance/rate risk at the 2028 maturity.

NOI / operating statement not in the data set — current cash flow and DSCR can't be verified here. Loan covenants require DSC ≥1.35x (2026 I/O) / ≥1.30x post-amortization; confirm the property is meeting them.

Several legacy/long-term anchor leases (Hannaford original; Staples since 1994; TJ Maxx since 1994) are at low in-place rents ($8–$11 PSF) — below-market but with multiple renewal options the tenants control.

upsideItems.detail: ~96,000 SF of former-anchor vacancy (Sears 40k, Regal 29k, Big Lots 26.9k). Hobby Lobby takes 55,000 SF on 7/29/2026; backfilling the remainder is the core value-creation play, with a ~$3M TI/LC escrow in place.
Ground-leased and pad tenants post high sales at low occupancy cost (KFC $873 PSF / ~4%, Five Guys $787 / ~4%, Jersey Mike's $710 / ~5%) — durable income and renewal/extension optionality.
Hannaford, Staples and TJ Maxx sit at $8–$11 PSF; mark-to-market on renewal/re-tenanting is available over time (gated by tenant renewal options).
